leadText: Yuki Koide (Japanese: 小出優希 Koide Yūki) is a main character in A Pocketful of Adventures.
plainText:
Yuki Koide (Japanese: 小出優希 Koide Yūki) is a main character in A Pocketful of Adventures. 
==History==
===Season One===
 
 
==Character==
Koide is quite clumsy, which earned him comparison to a by Madoka. Despite this, he tries to do what he can for ADventure and his co-workers. With Madoka's help, he managed to demonstrate a firmer stance and impose himself before Erika, even though after that, he still maintained some of his characteristics.
